visualAssessment.inspectionMethod: Manual inspection of the unretouched 514×411 Chromium Ground Glass captures and contact sheets at native display size.
visualAssessment.tabletopVisibility: The tabletop appears as a narrow band near the frame edge; its wood grain and seed-to-seed differences are not reliably inspectable at normal display size.
visualAssessment.focusDetailVisibility: Near, middle, and far focus-detail points project inside the film, but their markings remain too small to read in the photographic captures.
visualAssessment.framing: LIMITED: only the far pair of projected tabletop top corners lies inside the film; the near pair is clipped. Front Tilt changes focus-plane orientation but does not materially reframe the scene.
visualAssessment.rawUpright: Correct: Raw shows the inverted subject band near the top; Upright Assist places it near the bottom.
visualAssessment.f56SupportingView: The normal f/5.6 capture is very bright with a washed-out background; it remains supporting evidence and is not used to qualify tabletop material visibility.
